Coronary heart disease: Dietary patterns


Given the strength of the evidence, the 2015–2020 and 2020–2025 Dietary Guidelines for Americans recommend the Mediter-
ranean dietary pattern as a healthy eating pattern to lower chronic disease risk. As highlighted at the end of this article (Utility of
omics in precision nutrition), incorporation of omics data into existing and new observational and interventional studies of the
